mission_09: BFS ordering: start from node 0, use a queue to visit neighbors in order. This creates a canonical ordering that reduces the space of possible sequences
The graph-level RNN takes the previous adjacency row as input and updates the graph hidden state. The node-level RNN generates each edge bit sequentially
For edge prediction, compute logit = h_node @ W_out, then sigmoid to get probability. Sample edge_bit ~ Bernoulli(prob) during generation
